label: FACIS Simulation — OPC UA Adapter
info:
FACIS Simulation — OPC UA Demo Server Adapter

Demo fixture, not a production OPC UA server. Exposes the latest
energy-meter snapshot as 13 Double variables so the industrial
ingestion reference flows have a live OPC UA source to read from
(services/industrial-ingestion-service/orce/).

Endpoint: opc.tcp://<pod>:4840, SecurityPolicy None, anonymous,
read-only. NodeIds: ns=1;s=FACIS.EnergyMeter.<metric> with the same
metric names as the Modbus register map (docs/api/modbus-reference.md).

Values refresh every second from the `latest_meters` global context
written by the Feeds tab, mirroring the Modbus adapter.
